parakeet: The word, the word, the word, nothing but the word. I woke up from that eight year span and realized that not one single thing had happened in the good. But there had been nothing but loss and loss and loss and loss and loss. And the first question I had was how much faith does it take for this God to finally respond? And why should it take so much faith for this God to respond? And I think that was the thing that really made me start to question it all. Because I said, if it takes this God so long to finally help, finally respond, or finally keep its word, then maybe I don't want it. Maybe I don't need it. And that was the thing that kind of woke me up and then set me on the pathway to question and look at everything. Wow.
